protocol: Same phase driver and data; only loader.rs library source changes. Three alternating fresh-process pairs per device;10 warmups/100 samples per phase. Every output checked after every iteration. No concurrent GPU runs or cache purge.

phases.boundary: submit ordered worker marker and wait
clone owned input bytes, allocate/upload native tensors, await each
download persistent native inputs to owned host tensors, await each
clone owned input bytes/map, submit run, wait, return all owned output bytes
clone handle map, submit retained native run and wait; no host readback within timing
clone handle map, submit retained native run, wait, download every output
clone persistent input/output maps, encode with reused fixed output buffers and public fence/readiness; no host readback within timing
clone persistent input/output maps, encode with reused fixed output buffers, public fence/readiness, download every output

measurements.cleanup: exact validation, diagnostic readback, output drop and Runtime::drain outside every measured interval
measurements.limits: Sequential warm stateless calls; persistent retained/Metal inputs and buffers prepared outside timing; no pipeline/device concurrency claim; loading observed separately without cache purge
